cohort: The study included all deliveries involving mothers aged 19 years or less at the Clinical County Hospital 'Saint Andrew the Apostle', Constanta, between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2023.
finding: In southeastern Romania, primiparity and low maternal education were independent predictors of cesarean delivery, while rural residence and low maternal education predicted preterm birth among adolescent mothers.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 58.3% of adolescent pregnancies and was independently predicted by primiparity and low maternal education.
